title: Official KPGU Admission Process Steps
content:
Introduction
Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara - Official Step-by-Step Admission Process: Step 1: Online Registration & Application Form Submission on the official KPGU portal (www.kpgu.ac.in) or ACPC Gujarat portal for engineering/pharmacy courses. Step 2: Document Submission & Verification of 10th/12th marksheets, entrance exam scorecards (KSET / GUJCET / NEET / ACPC), and photo ID.
